name: Kevin L. Ligon
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Kevin L. Ligon is a retired civil servant from the Veterans Health Administration's Greater Los Angeles Healthcare System. He wants to help small businesses fill empty storefronts and strengthen the local economy. He supports rent stabilization, maintaining walkable communities, and keeping small businesses in West Hollywood. He opposes renewing the city’s Flock Safety camera contract, saying citizens’ privacy should take priority. He supports wider sidewalks on Fountain Avenue for safety. He has said the city’s Fountain Avenue streetscape project will cause massive traffic backups. He supports creating a transit-oriented development alternative plan for West Hollywood.
